Vs.
Imran Ali ----- Condemned-Accused (absconding)
full_judgment: 23. It would be mentioned here that there is no plausible explanation offered by the accused-husband on record under which circumstances Shantona had died. The fact that the accused husband fled away from his house soon after occurrence, was very unusual and unnatural conduct of the accused-husband. The circumstances brought a record by the prosecution unequivocally indicate that Shantona is killed by her husband but thereafter he fled away. It is to be said that on the basis of circumstances brought on record that it was cold blooded offence. There is a presumption that husband is custodian of wife. He has to maintain his wife properly, when the deceased Shantona was in the exclusive custody of husband during incident had occurred. The offence committed by the accused husband had serious consequence and deserves to be punished by awarding appropriate punishment keeping in view of the social interest.
